system.description: This oval, sea-blue stone gives its bearer three additional dice to all Temperance rolls (allowing the character's Temperance dice pool to exceed five dice). This includes channeling Willpower through the Virtue. However, the bearer's player must roll the character's Temperance whenever the character wishes to act contrary to this Virtue, and the stone's bonus dice also count toward these rolls. The bearer of this hearthstone becomes exceptionally resistant to temptation, bribery or corruption. However, he also becomes virtually incapable of bias, deception, betrayal or impulsive action. There are similar hearthstones aligned with the other three Virtues.
